title: Malum Spirit Data for Grimoire of Gaia
description: Get Malum spirits from GoG mobs
body:
This is a datapack that specifies what spirits Grimoire of Gaia mobs drop when killed by a Malum Scythe. For instance, the Dryad will drop 2 Sacred spirits and 2 Earthen spirits. This creates futher integration and immersion for your modpack!

![Dryad with spirits](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46fde0041d3c87403c329909b2a56d02a680be88_0.webp)

[Generated with my Malum Spirit Data Python script.](https://github.com/Partonetrain/MalumSpiritDataGen)
